title: Cottage cheese vs. queso fresco: nutrition differences

seo.title: Cottage cheese vs. queso fresco: nutrition compared
seo.meta_description: Cottage cheese and queso fresco are both fresh cheeses but have very different water and fat contents. Compare USDA/current label values on an equal 100 g basis.
seo.search_intent: Compare cottage cheese and queso fresco nutrition

excerpt: Queso fresco is much denser than low-fat cottage cheese. A current 2% cottage label normalizes to about 87 calories, 12.7 g protein and 2 g fat/100 g; USDA queso fresco provides about 298 calories, 18.9 g protein and 23.4 g fat/100 g. Queso fresco has more protein by weight, but cottage has far more protein per calorie.
content_html:
Cottage cheese and queso fresco are both unripened cheeses, but fresh does not mean nutritionally identical. Water content and milkfat make a huge difference.

Equal 100 g comparison

2% cottageUSDA queso fresco
Calories~87298
Protein~12.7 g18.9 g
Fat~2.0 g23.4 g
Carbohydrate~3.3 g3.0 g

Queso fresco has about 6 g more protein per 100 g, but it also has more than three times the calories because it contains far more fat.

Protein per calorie flips the result

The cottage example provides roughly 14.6 g protein per 100 calories. Queso fresco provides about 6.3 g per 100 calories. If protein efficiency is the goal, low-fat cottage is stronger despite having less protein by weight.

Texture reflects processing

Cottage cheese retains loose curds in a moist dressing. Queso fresco is drained and formed into a more cohesive, sliceable cheese.

Calcium can be much higher in queso fresco

The USDA queso fresco foundation record contains about 602 mg calcium/100 g. The Good Culture 2% cottage serving provides 140 mg per 150 g, about 93 mg/100 g when normalized.

Which one should you use?

Choose cottage when you want a low-fat, high-protein base. Choose queso fresco when you want a firmer, richer cheese and its characteristic flavor. They can share a meal, but they do not fill the same nutritional niche.

faq.question: Which has more protein per 100 g?
faq.answer: Queso fresco: about 18.9 g versus 12.7 g in the 2% cottage example.

faq.question: Which has fewer calories?
faq.answer: Cottage by a wide margin: about 87 versus 298 calories/100 g.

faq.question: Which has more protein per calorie?
faq.answer: The low-fat cottage example, roughly 14.6 g per 100 calories versus 6.3 g in queso fresco.

faq.question: Which has more calcium?
faq.answer: The USDA queso fresco reference, about 602 mg/100 g versus roughly 93 mg in the normalized cottage example.
